installation.summary: Beta access is handled personally by the outabit team through TestFlight.
steps: New tester? Request beta access below and follow the invitation sent by the outabit team.
Already testing? Open TestFlight, select outabit, and install the update offered to you. Look for build 54.
Keep the existing app installed when updating. If build 54 is not offered, contact support rather than deleting your app.

releases.label: v32 — version 1.1 — build 2026101232
added: A dedicated Lap Dashboard with a neutral Time or Distance comparison, lap history wheel and optional automatic focus after recording a lap.
Six coordinated appearance palettes with live dashboard previews and a dashboard long-press shortcut to Appearance.
Clearer Screen 1, Lap Dashboard, Digital Cluster and Map dashboard layouts with larger speed readings and aligned Trip and Odometer values.
fixed: Sleeping bicycle sensors no longer hold one connection attempt indefinitely; bounded attempts keep retrying and the generic disconnected warning waits two minutes while the amber indicator remains visible.
History and Trip reports now target support@outabit.com.
Finish has a safe Cancel path, dashboard controls have more forgiving touch areas, and routine continuation or startup sensor notices can be acknowledged.
knownIssues: The green return arrow can overlap the bottom map legend on the Map & Digital Dashboard.
The new sleeping-sensor retry behavior passed automated tests but has not yet been validated with a sleeping physical sensor on this build.
testFocus: Start an outing while the bicycle sensor is asleep, then wake it by turning the wheel within two minutes; confirm the sensor changes from amber to green and begins reading.
Review Screens 1 through 4 in portrait and landscape, especially speed, Trip and Odometer alignment and long readings.
Press Lap with automatic focus on and off, then check the neutral reference switch and lap-history wheel.

releases.label: Build 54
added: Customizable activities, so you can make outabit fit the way you get outside.
knownIssues: A build-specific known-issues list is not yet documented here. Please report anything unexpected.
testFocus: Try your Bluetooth sensor: finding it, connecting, viewing readings, and reconnecting after it has been disconnected.
Try customizing activities, then check that your choices and existing outing history remain as expected.

installation.summary: Ask the outabit team for beta access and the official Android installation instructions.
steps: New tester? Request beta access below. Use only the official installer and instructions provided by the outabit team.
Already testing? Install the new beta over your existing beta app. Do not uninstall first, as this can remove local outings and settings.
Keep Android security protections enabled. Stop and contact support if you see an unexpected signing or package mismatch.

releases.label: v26 · version 1.1 · build 2026101226
added: Custom activities: add, rename, reorder, hide and restore activities, with independent goals and default screens. Hidden activities with outings remain in Stats.
Bluetooth sensor discovery now includes unnamed devices, merges duplicate advertisements, shows signal strength and sorts stronger signals first.
Compatibility clues distinguish previously connected sensors, likely compatible sensors and devices with unknown compatibility. Services are checked after you select Connect.
Long-press an activity on Home to customize it, with a direct return to Home.
fixed: Normal Cancel no longer shows a misleading lost-sensor warning.
Empty Stats activity rows are omitted, and empty periods are explained.
knownIssues: A build-specific known-issues list is not yet documented here. Please report anything unexpected.
testFocus: Check sensor discovery, live readings and reconnect behavior with your own sensor.
Try customizing and hiding activities; verify that saved outings and settings remain intact after updating.

releases.label: Earlier beta · v4 · build 2026101204
added: Compact Settings with focused detail pages.
An explicit Save to Gallery action for outing images.
fixed: Corrected Android native dependency packaging and retained the shared-object lifetime fix for asynchronous native calls.
